command.description: MAV_CMD name as in the MAVLink spec ("MAV_CMD_NAV_TAKEOFF") or MP's short form ("TAKEOFF"), or number.

params.description: Up to 7 params; missing ones are 0. For COMMAND_INT params 5/6 are lat/lon in degE7.
